# Twenty

The #1 Open-Source CRM. Modern, powerful, affordable platform to manage your customer relationships.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/twenty/.

## Actions

- **Batch Create CRM Records**: Create 1-60 records of one type.
- **Create CRM Record**: Create one company, person, opportunity, or task using the supported standard fields in the parameter schema.
- **Delete CRM Record**: Permanently delete one company, person, opportunity, or task by UUID.
- **Get CRM Record** (read-only): Get one company, person, opportunity, or task by its Twenty UUID, optionally including direct relations.
- **List CRM Fields** (read-only): List field definitions from the connected Twenty workspace to discover exact field names, types, editability, nullability, uniqueness, and…
- **List CRM Objects** (read-only): List standard and custom object definitions in the connected Twenty workspace for schema inspection.
- **List CRM Records** (read-only): List companies, people, opportunities, or tasks with Twenty filter syntax, ordering, relation depth, and forward cursor pagination.
- **Update CRM Record**: Partially update one company, person, opportunity, or task by UUID using the supported standard fields in the parameter schema.
